cases.title: creates a throwaway fixture freight forwarder for this suite to edit

steps.data: Logged in and navigated to Service Providers > Freight Forwarders
Create a freight forwarder via FreightForwardersPage.createFreightForwarder(buildFakeFreightForwarderData()) so later scenarios never mutate a real, pre-existing record

cases.title: updates a freight forwarder's contact details

steps.target: Contact Name, Telephone Number, Email, Fax

steps.expected: "Freight forwarder updated successfully." banner is shown on the redirected detail page, which displays the new contact name, telephone number, and email

cases.title: updates a freight forwarder's company name and location

steps.expected: Detail page heading shows the new company name
Index, searched by the new name, shows a row with the new name and "{city}, United States" location

riskNotes: The Location column is "{city}, {country}", not "{state}, {country}" like Suppliers — verified live, see project_conventions.md.

cases.title: shows a validation error when Company Name is cleared

steps.expected: "The company name field is required." validation banner is shown
Index still shows the record under its original (unchanged) name
